ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous high-intensity white fields cover the majority of both lobes. A centralized, irregularly shaped low-intensity black blob is localized at the median notch. Minor low-intensity focal spots are distributed across the mid-ventral surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle and high bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley height is most pronounced at the distal lobe segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical concave curve sweeping upward and outward from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation patch features a 'flame-like' irregular perimeter extending toward the center of each lobe.
